name: Samantha Paranavitana
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a Core Process Psychotherapist, CPP is mindfulness based and depth relational. My approach is a deeply embodied, trauma informed. strength based and resilience focused. I strive to create a deeply nourishing and safe space in which my clients feel held and supported through whatever circumstances and challenges they bring to therapy.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Arnaud Domange
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Bonjour, My therapeutic approach is Person-Centered, attachment-based, and psychodynamic, with a strong emotion-focused and body-aware orientation. I work in a direct yet respectful manner, helping individuals understand not only what they are struggling with but also why specific patterns, emotions, or difficulties recur. Rather than focusing solely on symptom management, I aim to work with the underlying emotional, relational, and attachment-based processes that shape distress.

name: Noyonika Banik
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: As a dedicated counsellor, I provide compassionate, evidence-based support to children, adults, and families navigating life’s challenges. With extensive experience in areas such as trauma, mental health, and family dynamics, I create a warm, non-judgmental space where clients feel understood and empowered. My approach focuses on fostering resilience and emotional well-being, helping clients not just cope but thrive.

name: Jane Steel
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: At Pathways Psychotherapy, we offer a safe and supportive space for people seeking understanding, healing and meaningful change. I primarily work with women, men and young people who feel the need for support for their trauma, grief and challenges related to attachment and interpersonal relationships. My approach is compassionate, collaborative, and grounded in the belief that healing happens within a trusting therapeutic relationship.

name: Monica Hadges
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Dr Monica Hadges is a Focused Psychological Strategies Medicare Provider, Accredited Mental Health Social Worker and Counselling Psychotherapist. Offering relational Tele-mental health services (Nationally). Individual strength-focused therapeutic engagement to support resilience and improve coping skills with adults and young people.

name: Georgia Raper
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I'm a psychotherapist with a background in education and special education, which has shaped my practical, grounded approach and my understanding of neurodivergence, learning differences, and the emotional lives of young people. I work with children, teenagers, and adults using narrative therapy, expressive arts, IFS-informed approaches, somatic work, and ACT, adapting my style to suit each person. Areas of focus: - Anxiety and emotional overwhelm - Grief and loss - Trauma - Neurodivergence and learning differences - School refusal and demand avoidance - Identity and existential concerns - Complex and profound disability - Learning intervention and parent support
